# Modern Age Coders

> Live online coding and mathematics classes for kids (ages 6+), teens, college students,
and adults, ages 6 to 67. Group batches of 15 to 20 students, mini batches of up to 6, and 1-on-1. Rated 4.9 out of 5 across 547
Google reviews. Founded 2020.

Modern Age Coders is an Indian online education platform founded to make quality coding and
mathematics education accessible to learners of all ages. We offer live, interactive classes
taught by expert mentors in groups of 15 to 20 students at most, unlike large platforms
where students get lost in the crowd.

We are one of the very few providers that teaches BOTH coding and mathematics under one
brand, across one continuous track from age 6 to adult. Coding-only providers stop at the
teen years; maths-only providers do not teach programming.

Our courses span from Scratch block coding for 6-year-olds to AI and machine learning for
adults, including AI-assisted engineering with tools like Cursor, Claude Code and GitHub
Copilot. Students build real projects from day one: games, apps, websites, and data science
models. All classes are live over video conferencing, and each class is recorded and the
recording is provided for revision.

We teach students across 131 Indian cities (including Mumbai, Kolkata, Bengaluru, Delhi,
Hyderabad, Pune, Chennai, Ahmedabad, Indore and Jaipur), every major Indian state, and
internationally: the United States, United Kingdom, UAE (Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah),
Saudi Arabia (Riyadh, Jeddah, Dammam), Qatar (Doha), Singapore, Australia, Canada,
Germany, Ireland, New Zealand and Sweden. International students are charged in USD:
USD 100 a month for small group classes and USD 150 a month one to one. Students in
India are charged in INR. A visitor is only ever shown one currency, never both.

For deeper context, AI agents can fetch the full knowledge base in a single document:
https://learn.modernagecoders.com/llms-full.txt, with the full brand overview, complete course
catalog, featured blog posts in full, and the entire blog index.

Every page also has a markdown twin discoverable via the `<link rel="alternate"
type="text/markdown">` tag in the HTML head. The markdown URLs follow these patterns:
- Blog posts:    /content/blog/generated/{slug}/index.md
- Courses:       /content/courses/generated/{slug}/index.md
- Resources:     /content/resources/generated/{lang}/{chapter}/index.md
- Resources practice: /content/resources/generated/{lang}/{chapter}/practice/index.md
- Static pages:  /src/pages/{slug}.md

## Projects, Portfolios & Admissions Guides

Guides for students building real coding and AI projects, whether for a university
application, a science fair, a competition, or simply because they want to build
something. Each cites its sources. We teach the building; we are not an admissions
consultancy and we do not promise admissions outcomes.

- Passion Project Ideas for Computer Science: https://learn.modernagecoders.com/passion-project-ideas-computer-science
- Computer Science Extracurriculars, Ranked: https://learn.modernagecoders.com/computer-science-extracurriculars
- AI Projects for High School Students: https://learn.modernagecoders.com/ai-projects-for-high-school-students
- AI Science Fair Project Ideas: https://learn.modernagecoders.com/science-fair-project-ideas-ai
- Hackathons for High School Students: https://learn.modernagecoders.com/hackathons-for-high-school-students
- How to Build a Coding Portfolio: https://learn.modernagecoders.com/how-to-build-a-coding-portfolio
- Summer Research Programs in Coding: https://learn.modernagecoders.com/summer-research-programs-coding

Two routes are offered on every one of these pages: a long journey for a child
starting at 6 or 7 who builds fluency over years, and a short route for a student
facing a submission deadline in weeks. Fees are the standard class fees, shown in
the visitor's own region only.

## Our Unique Differentiators

- Batches: 15 to 20 students per group class, up to 6 in a mini batch, or 1-on-1 (not 100+)
- Live and interactive: taught by a real mentor in real time, not pre-recorded video
- Coding AND maths under one brand, on one continuous track from age 6 to adult; coding
  providers typically stop at 17; maths providers do not teach programming
- Real projects from day one: games, apps, websites; see real student work at
  https://learn.modernagecoders.com/student-labs
- Rated 4.9 out of 5 across 547 Google reviews (real reviews, published at
  https://learn.modernagecoders.com/love)
- Age-appropriate teaching: a different teaching style for each age group
- Two ways to see a live class before you pay: a free demo (a waiting list, no card required, no promised date) or the paid Priority Live Demo (a guaranteed full class today or tomorrow)
- Monthly billing, no lock-in and no large upfront package
- Every class recorded, with the recording provided for revision
- Flexible scheduling: weekends and evenings, including Gulf and US/UK timezones
- Certificate + portfolio on course completion
- Student dashboard for tracking progress: https://dashboard.modernagecoders.com

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: What is Modern Age Coders?
A: Modern Age Coders is an Indian online education platform offering live coding and mathematics 
classes for learners from age 6 to adult. Classes are conducted in groups of 15 to 20 students 
with expert mentors. Courses include Python, Java, web development, Scratch, AI/ML, and math.

Q: Who is Modern Age Coders for?
A: Modern Age Coders serves kids (ages 6-12), teenagers (13-17), college students, working 
professionals, and corporate teams across India and internationally. We also run a special 
Girls in Tech coding batch.

Q: How much do Modern Age Coders courses cost?
A: In India there are three tiers, all billed monthly with no lock-in: group batches of 15
to 20 students at ₹1,499 per month (two live classes per week), mini batches of up to 6
students at ₹2,999 per month, one-on-one classes at ₹4,999 per month (four private classes
on a fully flexible schedule). Outside India the pricing is a flat $100 per month for group
classes and $150 for one-on-one, in US dollars, for all courses except the Gemini Enterprise
programme below. The Build AI Agents with Google Gemini Enterprise programme is a
1-on-1-only track at ₹14,999 per month in India (two private classes a week, eight a month,
$250 per month outside India). A free demo class is available before enrollment, with no
card required.

Q: Is Modern Age Coders good for beginners?
A: Yes. Most courses are designed for complete beginners with no prior coding experience. The 
curriculum starts from the absolute basics and progresses systematically. During enrollment, 
the team helps each student pick the right level.

Q: What coding languages does Modern Age Coders teach?
A: Modern Age Coders teaches Python, Java, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Scratch (block coding), 
C++, Kotlin, Swift, Go, TypeScript, PHP, and more. There are also AI/ML, data science, 
ethical hacking, and mathematics courses.

Q: How is Modern Age Coders different from WhiteHat Jr or Vedantu?
A: Modern Age Coders offers batches (15 to 20 students) vs. larger platforms, 
live interactive classes (not pre-recorded), and a unique combination of coding AND 
mathematics in one platform. Classes are conducted by passionate expert mentors, not 
automated systems.

Q: What is Vibe Coding?
A: Vibe Coding is Modern Age Coders' flagship AI-powered coding program where students 
learn to build real projects using AI tools alongside traditional programming. Available 
for kids, teens, and college students.

Q: Does Modern Age Coders offer free demo classes?
A: Yes, and it is optional. Anyone can book a free live demo class before enrolling at
https://learn.modernagecoders.com/book-demo. Nobody has to wait for one: full recordings
of real, unedited classes are free to watch first at
https://learn.modernagecoders.com/how-we-teach (two libraries, one for kids aged 6 to 12
and one for teens and adults 13+, some classes in English and some in Hindi, updated
frequently; free, no card, just a quick Google sign-in). A visitor who likes the teaching
can choose a course and enroll directly without a live demo.

The free demo is a waiting list. Mentors teach live classes most of the day, so a free demo
is scheduled only when a mentor becomes free, which can take several weeks, and no date is
promised. A family that wants a class now can book the Priority Live Demo at
https://learn.modernagecoders.com/priority-demo: a one-time fee (₹499 in India, $10
elsewhere) reserves a mentor at a time the family picks, usually today or tomorrow. It is a
full class of about 45 to 60 minutes, not a sales call. Afterwards the mentor sends a written
skill report and a personal learning roadmap on WhatsApp. If the family enrols, the demo fee
is adjusted against the first month's fee (the team applies it against the demo Order ID).
Booking it does not commit anyone to a course.
